faqs.a: Yes. Events, Moi entries, helpers, receipts, reports and the Moi Book are free to use. Every new event also gets 20 free message credits for receipts and invitations on WhatsApp or SMS.

faqs.q: Do guests need to install anything?
faqs.a: No. Guests scan the event QR or open the link on any phone and confirm their mobile with a one-time code. Families and helpers use the app in the browser.

faqs.q: What if the hall has no internet?
faqs.a: Keep recording. Entries are saved on the phone and sync when the internet is back.

faqs.q: Can I use it in my language?
faqs.a: Yes. The app, voice entry, receipts and the Moi Book work in English and ten Indian languages: Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Punjabi and Odia.

faqs.q: Can I use it outside India?
faqs.a: Yes. Families anywhere can use Moi Point on a phone or laptop. One-time codes and WhatsApp receipts go to Indian (+91) mobile numbers.

faqs.q: Can a helper see other functions?
faqs.a: No. Each collector login sees only the event and the days you allow.

faqs.q: Can I correct a wrong entry?
faqs.a: Yes. Edit it, or void it with a reason. Nothing is ever deleted, and numbers never repeat.

blog.title: How to set up the Moi counter for a 500-guest wedding
blog.excerpt: Two collectors, one QR at the entrance and a printed backup sheet: a simple plan that works.
blog.body: A busy wedding can see hundreds of guests in an hour. Give the counter two phones with collector logins, place the event QR at the entrance so guests can fill their own details, and keep one printed sheet for the rare moment the internet is down. Moi Point saves entries offline and syncs later, so the counter never stops.

blog.title: Why every guest should get a Moi receipt
blog.excerpt: A receipt with a number and a QR settles every “did you get my Moi?” question for good.
blog.body: When every Moi has a running number and a receipt on WhatsApp, there are no doubts later. Guests feel respected, and the family has a clean record to look back on when it is time to return the Moi at the guest’s own function.

blog.title: Returning Moi: keep the balance right for years
blog.excerpt: Link what you give back to what you received, person by person.
blog.body: Moi is a relationship that runs for decades. Record each return against the guest’s earlier Moi and the balance stays right, even years later. Reminders tell you when their function is coming up.
